source.title: Experimental investigation of fluctuating forces exerted on a cylindrical tube (Reynolds numbers from 3000 to 30000)
source.authors: H. Tadrist, R. Martin, L. Tadrist, and P. Seguin
source.locator: Physics of Fluids A 2(12), printed pp. 2176-2182; apparatus pp. 2177-2178; force standard deviation and Fig. 6 p. 2179; span/end/blockage discussion p. 2180

source_artifact.provenance: user supplied and explicitly authorized the lawful complete PDF for accuracy validation on 2026-08-22

observables.name: direct_global_lift_measurement_re_min
observables.definition: minimum Reynolds number of the reported direct global fluctuating-lift measurements

observables.name: direct_global_lift_measurement_re_max
observables.definition: maximum Reynolds number of the reported direct global fluctuating-lift measurements

observables.name: upstream_turbulence_intensity
observables.definition: Tu=sigma_u/U for upstream velocities above 4 m/s; reported velocity-independent
observables.source_locator: printed p. 2177, Eq. 13 and adjacent prose

observables.name: global_lift_coefficient_prose_re3000_endpoint
observables.definition: approximate lower prose endpoint of the plotted global lift coefficient over Re=3000-7000; not a point-labelled Re=3900 value
observables.source_locator: printed p. 2179, Section IV.A and Fig. 6
observables.extraction_method: direct approximate prose endpoint; no graph digitization or interpolation

observables.name: global_lift_coefficient_prose_re7000_endpoint
observables.definition: approximate upper prose endpoint of the plotted global lift coefficient over Re=3000-7000; not a point-labelled Re=3900 value
observables.source_locator: printed p. 2179, Section IV.A and Fig. 6
observables.extraction_method: direct approximate prose endpoint; no graph digitization or interpolation

observables.name: force_spectrum_band_choice_relative_difference
observables.definition: reported approximate difference between lift force evaluated from the full vortex-shedding band and from the midheight band; this is a band-choice sensitivity, not measurement uncertainty
observables.source_locator: printed p. 2179, Section III.3 following Eq. 15
observables.extraction_method: direct prose value, explicitly excluded from experimental uncertainty

observables.name: adopted_correlation_length_over_d
observables.definition: lambda_c/D adopted from Surry and Sonneville to derive local lift from the directly measured global coefficient; not measured in the Tadrist experiment
observables.source_locator: printed p. 2180, paragraph applying relation 10 to Fig. 8
observables.extraction_method: direct source model input; classified as derived/non-measured

excluded_as_release_oracles: Fig. 6 has no tabulated or point-labelled Re=3900 global lift value
the prose 0.02-0.08 range over Re=3000-7000 is an advisory target-neighborhood envelope, not an exact Re=3900 tolerance
lambda_c=4D is adopted from other studies and does not by itself establish periodic pi-D span equivalence
the reported 7% band-choice difference is not a measurement uncertainty
the experiment reports no Tadrist total mean-drag value
